goal: How to make a simple camping lantern.
candidate_1: Use a 1 gallon milk jug filled with batter operated fairy lights to create a stylish and simple camping lantern.
candidate_2: Simply set an empty clean 1 gallon milk jug made of translucent plastic on top of an led light. Or, you can strap a headlamp led light to the milk jug with the light facing the jug.
